newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices maintain strength with natgas.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices maintain strength with natgas.

text.p: Bulk wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) maintained strength Thursday in tandem with strong natural gas prices, industry sources said.
Power price strength was also coming from supply constraints due to generating plant maintenance outages, the brokers and marketers said.

Lower Colorado River Authority's 430 megawatt natural gas-fired Ferguson power plant, which was taken off line last week for a boiler tube repair, was expected to resume operations late Saturday or early Sunday, the company said.
Texas spot gas prices surged Thursday morning then eased to just below Wednesday's strong levels.
Peak, firm electricity in ERCOT for Friday delivery was quoted mostly steady in the $24.00-26.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) range, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak ERCOT power for Friday delivery was said to have risen to $13.00-15.00 from $12.00-13.00 per MWh.
November ERCOT electricity was talked steady at $20.25-20.50, while December was assessed steady to higher in the $22.25-22.50 range from $22.00-22.50 on Wednesday, the sources said.
Weather forecasts were bearish for Texas electricity, with normal to below-normal temperatures expected through much of the state from October 22 to 26.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
